notes.title: Vampire Nights: Horny Secret is available now!
notes.notes:
Dedicate this evening to noble girls, dirty secrets, and the investigation of a mystical disappearance with the protagonist of the visual novel. He is smart, talented, and always eager to find answers to questions, even if they are outside his normal perception of the world. He'll have to deal with all kinds of obstacles (some of which will be quite unpleasant, while others will be highly entertaining) and, of course, vampires lurking in the shadows along the way. Although the hero, like you, will definitely overcome all the challenges and get spicy rewards💋.

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Great news! Vampire Nights: Horny Secret will be released already on February 14th. 
The visual novel features the passage of in-game days, during which the player has to meet various girls while learning information about the mysterious disappearance of a lord's wife.

Make your wildest dreams come true, try new emotions and dive into the darkness soon.

And don't forget to add the game to your Wishlist so you don't miss out on the release and special offers.
